donor_disposition.adapt: Direct /home scan (home_targets_scan, archive/securelinux-ng.sh) is the sole population source; /etc/passwd is not consulted (decision 22.09.2026, supersedes the earlier v2 all-passwd-rows model).
donor_disposition.reject: Donor silently skips symlinks and non-directories under /home; this product fails closed instead (ERROR, with path and readlink target for the entry that stopped population) because the product surfaces don't-know states rather than dropping them from the population.

evidence_scope: Seven privileged read-only VM runs (see vm_evidence) exercised the earlier all-passwd-rows population heuristic and home modes; observed modes do not redefine the normative value 0700. The population source changed 22.09.2026 (decision: direct /home entries, not /etc/passwd); vm_evidence below predates that change and its candidate_accounts/existing_homes fields describe the old passwd-based counting model, not the current checked= count.

non_requirements.existence: SRC-0015 does not require creation of /home or of any entry under it; an absent /home (with a searchable ancestor) or an empty /home is outside the mode population and is VALUE/PASS with checked=0;violations=0.
non_requirements.ownership: Owner/group equality is not part of SRC-0015.
non_requirements.passwd_home_field: The home= field of /etc/passwd has no effect on this control: population comes exclusively from direct (mindepth=1,maxdepth=1) entries of /home (decision 22.09.2026).
non_requirements.sensitive_files: Sensitive file modes belong to SRC-0014 and are not rechecked here.

permissions_control.comparison: For each direct /home entry that is a real directory (not a symlink), permission/special bits must equal 0700; this is the exact chmod 700 relation.
permissions_control.fail: VALUE/FAIL when one or more checked entries have a mode other than 0700.
permissions_control.pass: VALUE/PASS when the population is fully evaluated (including an absent or empty /home) and violations=0.

population.absent_root: /home missing, with a searchable ancestor => VALUE/PASS, checked=0;violations=0 (ERROR home-base:ancestor-symlink / home-base:ancestor-invalid-type / home-base:ancestor-unsearchable when the ancestor itself is not a searchable directory).
population.authority: Direct entries of /home (find -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1); /etc/passwd is not read at all.
population.entry_state: Each direct entry must be a real directory and must not be a symlink (symlinks are never followed for type classification): a symlink entry => ERROR home:symlink:<path>-><readlink target> (target omitted only when readlink itself fails, e.g. a TOCTOU race); any other non-directory type (regular file, FIFO, socket, device) => ERROR home:not-directory:<path>. An entry name or symlink target containing a tab, CR or LF byte would corrupt the tab-delimited wire row, so that object is reported as ERROR home:invalid-name instead of embedding the raw bytes.
population.home_base_not_directory: /home existing but not a directory => ERROR home-base:invalid-type.
population.home_base_symlink: /home itself being a symlink => ERROR home-base:symlink (not followed).
population.scan_failure: A read error enumerating /home (EACCES, etc.) => ERROR scan:find-failed / scan:sort-failed / scan:missing-marker / scan:invalid-marker, never a mutation-eligible PASS on a partial population.
